entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The depths of Mementos is likely what[n]awaits us down there... Are you ready to[n]descend, Joker?
entries.uk: Унизу на нас, певно, чекають глибини[n]Мементосу... Ти готовий спуститися,[n]Джокере?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay. It's better to be prepared for[n]whatever might be down there.
